_comment: Source of truth for the generated regions of roku.html: the hero button, the
beta section and the blog link in the credits.
Rendered by scripts/render-roku.mjs, which runs as part of `npm run build`;
`npm test` fails if roku.html is out of date with this file.
Never hand-edit between the ROKU-* markers in roku.html; edit this and re-render.
betaFull is the one switch. false: the beta has room, so the hero button and
step 1 go to the Roku add link and the page shows the access code. true: Roku's
20 tester spots are taken, so the add link and the code come off the page and
the hero and the beta section lead with the Discord button. Flip it, run
`npm run roku:render` (or `npm run build`), and commit roku.html with it.
announcementPost: the slug of the Roku announcement post in content/blog/, or
null. Once set, the credits section links to /blog/<slug>. The render fails if
the post does not exist or is still a draft, so the page never links a 404.
storeLive is the switch above the switch. true: the app is on the Roku Channel
Store, so the hero button goes to storeAddUrl and the whole beta section comes
off the page, whatever betaFull says. false: the beta page as it was, driven by
betaFull. storeLive only drives the generated regions. The words around them
(hero line, step 1, the FAQ, the meta descriptions) are plain text in roku.html.
